name: Deakin interest-free student loan
summary: Interest-free loans of up to $2,000 for Deakin students in financial difficulty, for textbooks, equipment, technology and placement costs.
key: Up to $2,000 at any one time.
who: Currently enrolled Deakin student (domestic or international) living in Australia.
Experiencing financial difficulty affecting your study.
Progressing satisfactorily and able to repay.
how: Complete the single financial assistance form with photo ID, three months of bank statements and income and expense details.
You can expect to hear within 3 business days.
catches: Loans of $501 to $2,000 need a guarantor. First-year, first-study-period students need one for any loan.
Must be repaid within two years. Can't be used for tuition.

evidence.quote: The maximum loan amount is $2000 at any one time
Loans of $501–$2000 must have a guarantor
